description: Add distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry trace propagation from gateway to worker. Create engine/internal/gateway/tracing.go with span creation for dispatch, scale, execute operations. Inject trace context into worker HTTP requests using otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject(). Extract trace context in worker handler. Enhance structured logging with request_id, trace_id, group in all log lines.
steps: Read engine/internal/observ/tracer.go to understand existing OTEL setup (otelTracer, StartSpan, TraceIDFromContext)
Read engine/internal/gateway/client.go propagateTraceHeaders() to understand current header propagation (X-Request-Id, X-Trace-Id, traceparent)

Create engine/internal/gateway/tracing.go with TracingMiddleware and span utilities: StartDispatchSpan(ctx, group, flowID), StartScaleSpan(ctx, group, action), InjectTraceContext(ctx, req *http.Request)
Update InjectTraceContext to use go.opentelemetry.io/otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject(ctx, propagation.HeaderCarrier(req.Header)) for W3C trace context
Add go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation to go.mod if not present
Update engine/internal/gateway/dispatcher.go Dispatch(): wrap execution in a span using tracer.Start(ctx, 'gateway.dispatch'), set attributes group and flow_id, call span.End(err) on completion
Update engine/internal/gateway/scaler.go EnsureReady(), ScaleUp(), ScaleDown(): wrap in spans 'gateway.scale.ensure_ready', 'gateway.scale.up', 'gateway.scale.down'
Update engine/internal/gateway/client.go doExecute(): replace manual header propagation with InjectTraceContext call
Update engine/internal/worker/handler.go handleExecute(): extract trace context from headers using otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract(), create child span 'worker.execute', set flow_id attribute
Update all log.Emit() calls in gateway/ and worker/ to include 'group' field in addition to existing request_id, trace_id
Create engine/internal/gateway/tracing_test.go with tests for trace propagation
Update engine/internal/worker/handler_test.go to verify trace extraction
acceptance_criteria: go build ./cmd/engine && go build ./cmd/worker compiles without errors
go test ./internal/gateway/... passes including tracing tests
go test ./internal/worker/... passes including handler tests
When dispatching a request through gateway to worker, the trace_id in gateway logs matches trace_id in worker logs
All log lines include request_id, trace_id, and group fields
findings:
Implemented distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry for gateway-worker communication:

1. Created engine/internal/gateway/tracing.go with:
   - InjectTraceContext(ctx, req) - W3C trace context injection using otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject()
   - ExtractTraceContext(ctx, r) - W3C trace context extraction using otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract()
   - StartDispatchSpan(ctx, tracer, group, flowID) - Creates 'gateway.dispatch' span
   - StartScaleSpan(ctx, tracer, action, group) - Creates 'gateway.scale.*' spans
   - StartClientSpan(ctx, tracer, group, endpoint) - Creates 'gateway.client.execute' span
   - StartWorkerExecuteSpan(ctx, tracer, flowID, group) - Creates 'worker.execute' span
   - TracingFields(ctx, group) - Extracts request_id, trace_id, group from context
   - MergeFields(base, extra) - Merges field maps for logging

2. Updated client.go:
   - propagateTraceHeaders() now calls InjectTraceContext() for W3C compliant propagation
   - Removed manual traceparent header construction

3. Updated dispatcher.go:
   - Added tracer field and SetTracer() method
   - Added NewDispatcherWithTracing() constructor
   - Dispatch() now starts 'gateway.dispatch' span with group, flow_id attributes
   - Log lines now include group via TracingFields() helper
   - Span records error details on failure

4. Updated scaler.go:
   - Added tracer field to Scaler and ScalerConfig
   - EnsureReady() starts 'gateway.scale.ensure_ready' span with scaling_mode attribute
   - ScaleUp() starts 'gateway.scale.up' span with current/target replicas
   - ScaleDown() starts 'gateway.scale.down' span with scaling_mode attribute

5. Updated handler.go:
   - Extracts trace context from headers using otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract()
   - Creates 'worker.execute' span with flow_id, group, request_id attributes
   - Sets up RequestScope in context for proper trace ID propagation
   - Prefers OTel trace ID over header trace ID when both present

6. Updated worker.go:
   - Added Tracer() getter method to expose tracer for handler

7. Created comprehensive tests in tracing_test.go:
   - TestInjectTraceContext_WithOTelContext - Verifies traceparent and X-Trace-Id headers
   - TestInjectTraceContext_WithRequestScope - Verifies custom headers from scope
   - TestExtractTraceContext_WithTraceparent - Verifies trace ID extraction
   - TestStartDispatchSpan - Verifies span name and attributes
   - TestTracingFields - Verifies field extraction from context
   - TestMergeFields - Verifies field merging behavior
